newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Harmony says Lydex review complete.
newsitem.headline: Harmony says Lydex review complete.

text.p: South African mining firm Harmony Gold Mining Co Ltd said on Tuesday that it had successfully completed a review of the business of Lydenburg Exploration Ltd and will now press on with an offer for the firm.
The offer comprises a cash payment of ten rand for every Lydex share and 45 options in Harmony for every 100 Lydex shares.
The total value of the deal is 14 rand a Lydex share.

Harmony has said it is making the buy in order to extend its operation beyond its mine's current lease boundaries and accelerate Harmony's development from a gold producer into a more broadly based and gold mining and exploration company.
